title: Nexus SimulationTrajectory
description: Deterministic trajectory of a candidate workflow document under a static walk (Simulate output). Produced from the request's candidate IR; nothing executes, no provider is called, and the input document is not mutated. The same IR yields the same bytes twice.

schema_version.description: Trajectory contract revision, fixed at 1 for this shape. A structural change bumps it; adding a `simulation_level` value does not.

ir_content_hash.description: BLAKE3 canonical content hash recomputed over the request's candidate IR. Never echoed from an optional request `content_hash`.

simulation_level.description: Open string naming how deeply the walk explored the graph. `reachability` is the only value v0 emits: judge branches are not explored (each `llm_judge` follows its declared default edge and is listed in `stubbed_judges`) and no provider is called. Consumers MUST treat an unknown value as a newer, unsupported level instead of failing deserialization or assuming `reachability`.

nodes_visited.description: Node ids reached from `entry`, in deterministic walk order.

items.title: SimulationPredictedWait
items.description: A statically predicted parking point. Static over-approximation: the wait may never fire at run time.

reason.description: Why the walk stops: a manual wait node, or a `pause` signal binding.

subject.description: Node id when `reason` is `manual`; signal name for a global `signals[].action: pause` binding, which has no target node.

effect_summary.description: Worst-case effect fence over the visited default-branch nodes and their nested children, compared by the total order `pure < read < write_candidate < external` (a parent is the maximum of its children). The generated Rust enum derives `Ord`/`PartialOrd` in exactly this declaration order, so consumers compare with those derives instead of a local rank table.

stubbed_judges.description: Node ids visited through an `exit_when.kind: llm_judge` whose declared default branch was followed without a model call.
